remarks: Beautiful and spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo filled with natural light and oversized windows throughout. Features include a brand-new kitchen, updated bathrooms, hardwood floors throughout, large bedrooms, central air, and two garage spaces. Convenient commuter-friendly location close to the SoNo train station, I-95, and just minutes to shopping, dining, and entertainment. Enjoy beach rights.
